description: Collectibles held by a wallet, from two independent readers: Magic Eden's index (names, collections, images, listing state) and the chain's own asset index (every standard, including compressed and unlisted items a marketplace may not carry). Answers 'what does this wallet hold', 'what is in my wallet', 'does this address own anything'. The two counts are compared and any gap is named. Read-only - this server never asks for keys and cannot move anything.

limit.description: How many items to read from the marketplace index. Default 50.

name: get_wallet_holdings
title: Wallet holdings
